hexcasting.page.almightly_staff.1: The $(item)Almightly Staff/$ appears as a book. it is a $(thing)grand unification/$ of all my hex-casting tools. It combines the multi-page iota storage of a $(l:items/spellbook)$(item)Spellbook/$, the scrying sight of a $(l:items/lens)$(item)Scrying Lens/$, and the casting interface of a $(l:items/staff)$(item)Staff/$ into a single implement.$(br2)With up to $(thing)sixty-four/$ pages, each capable of holding any iota, it also functions as a reusable spell-casting item.
hexcasting.page.almightly_staff.2: Using the staff is intuitive:$(br2)$(thing)Right-click/$ opens the familiar hex-casting grid, just like any $(l:items/staff)$(item)Staff/$. Iota can also be written directly in the usual manner, with pages turned by $(thing)sneak-scrolling/$ just as one would with a spellbook.$(br2)But the true power lies in the $(thing)V key/$. Once I have stored a spell, pressing $(k:almightly_staff.mode) instantly $(thing)casts/$ the iota on the active page;no fiddling with the grid required.
hexcasting.page.almightly_staff.3: But the true power lies in the $(thing)V key/$. Once I have stored a spell, pressing $(k:almightly_staff.mode) instantly $(thing)casts/$ the iota on the active page;no fiddling with the grid required.
hexcasting.page.almightly_staff.4: The $(thing)Staff IDE/$, opened with $(k:almightly_staff.ide), provides a powerful iota editing interface.$(br2)The $(thing)left panel/$ displays all iotas on the current page. Click any iota to place the $(thing)cursor/$, then use $(thing)Shift+Click/$ to select a range.$(br2)Bottom buttons provide $(thing)Copy(C)/Paste(V)/Cut(X)/Delete(Del)/$ operations on selected iotas, plus $(thing)Arrow keys/$ to move the cursor.
hexcasting.page.almightly_staff.5: The $(thing)right panel/$ features a hex-casting grid. In $(thing)Write(W) mode/$, each drawn pattern becomes a $(item)PatternIota/$ added to the list. In $(thing)Cast(C) mode/$, patterns are executed immediately.$(br2)The $(thing)Parse button/$ converts iotas to text code for editing. With $(item)HexParse/$ installed, you can write code directly and convert it back to iotas.$(br2)The $(thing)Spc and NL buttons/$ insert comment iotas for code formatting.
hexcasting.page.almightly_staff.crafting: $(italic)All is one, and one is all./$
almightly_staff.ide.title: ALL IN ONE
